newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's bourse resumes its downward trend.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's bourse resumes its downward trend.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Wednesday closed down by 0.13 percent in higher trade, bourse sources said.
The 31 share index closed at 451.44 points, down from 452.03 on Tuesday.
Total volume was 1.24 million dinars against 824,023 dinars over the previous session.
Airline Tunis Air fell 0.38 dinar to 23 dinars with 2,274 shares changing hands. Palm Beach Hotels was down 0.2 dinar to 9.8 dinars.
Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie eased 0.1 dinar to 29 dinars with the exchange of 1,755 shares.
Societe Tunisienne de Banque was up 0.22 dinar to 12.5.
Detergents firm SPCD rose 0.18 dinar to 29.2 dinars with 3,008 shares changing hands.
